summary: Tested Ideen-Button feature in Kantine-Speiseplan admin panel. Backend API /api/meal-suggestions and full UI flow (open modal, category selection, search filter, meal selection, close handlers) work end-to-end. All 12 backend pytest tests and 9 Playwright UI checks pass.

issues: Minor label inconsistency: API returns label 'Suppe/Eintopf' for 🥣 while admin UI displays 'Suppe'. Functionally fine since matching is by icon, but consider aligning for consistency.

action_items: Optional: align category label between API ('Suppe/Eintopf') and admin UI ('Suppe').
Optional: API has no explicit length cap and returns 158 Schwein meals — consider pagination or virtualized list for very large categories (current size is fine, just future-proofing).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/pages/admin.js is 1333 lines — violates the <700 lines guideline. Extracting IdeenModal into a separate component would improve maintainability.

weeksAgo computation in /app/pages/api/meal-suggestions.js uses (now - lastServed)/7days; for meals served this week this can yield 0 which the UI renders as 'zuletzt vor dieser Woche' — works, but consider documenting the rounding behavior.

fetchMealSuggestions uses `if (mealSuggestions) return;` to cache — there is no explicit refresh path, so newly added meals during a session won't appear until reload. Acceptable for admin tool but worth noting.
All idea-button data-testid attributes follow `idea-btn-<dayIndex>-<mealIndex>` pattern — good.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing MongoDB Atlas data (60 menus, ~509 unique meals already classified by icon).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Next.js monolith on port 3000. Use http://localhost:3000 (preview URL is broken per main agent). Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_meal_suggestions.py covers the meal-suggestions API. Admin UI testid pattern: idea-btn-{day}-{meal}, idea-modal, idea-modal-close, idea-modal-cancel, idea-cat-{label-lowercase}, idea-search, idea-meal-{idx}.
rca of the issue: No issues found — feature works as specified.
